meta.title: Short "Anecdote" (9:16)
meta.summary: One anecdote from an interview: the strongest sentence first as the hook, then context, the story with literal B-roll and the punchline.

concept.idea: A vertical short around one anecdote of an interview. The hook is the strongest sentence of the anecdote, placed first even if it comes later in the interview; context, the story with B-roll that illustrates literally what is said, and the punchline follow; the short ends with the animal scream and the logo end.

references.note: Analysis of the Loud Society shorts: doc/mvp/brand/ANALYSIS_YOUTUBE_SHORTS.md

material.label: B-roll that literally shows what is said

sections.title: Hook
sections.purpose: The strongest sentence with word captions and the wordmark flash over the first caption line; no lower third.

sections.title: Context
sections.purpose: Punch-out (crop), optionally an album sticker as a free extension (episode layer); an optional lower third after the hook.

sections.title: Story
sections.purpose: The story with B-roll that illustrates literally what is said.

sections.title: End
sections.purpose: animal_scream → logo_end (optionally revealed by a chevron_wipe).

wordmark_flash.role: in the hook, over the first caption line

lower_third.role: after the hook, at the context

music.note: the brand pack ships no music (T14)

rules.text: The hook is the strongest sentence of the anecdote, placed first even if it comes later in the interview (the editorial review shows the reordering).
B-roll illustrates literally what is said.
No transitions other than chevron_wipe and glitch_flash.
